why_not_copy_the_files: they are app-layer classes bound to ryeong's Room entity BusinessCardEntity, not our BusinessCard
nothing would call them — AppContainer wires RoomBusinessCardRepository → RyeongContactSearchBackend → SearchLookupService
a second parallel search stack would violate the dependency rules in CLAUDE.md
it would change no behaviour at all, which is the thing that actually differed
